services.desc: Well it’s shaping up to be an awesome year. We’ve seen warm water temps the past few weeks and the makos have been on the chew. If we see the even warmer water that we are expecting we could very well have top notch hammerhead fishing in the coming weeks. We have limited availability in June at this point and still some prime dates in July and August. Give us a holler and lets go sharkin We’ve had a good steady pick at the makos this season so far with many fish over 500 lbs in the last few weeks since they finally let us run charters again.
